name: Cassava rolled in rice paper
nameVi: khoai mì quết cuốn bánh tráng
summary: Mashed boiled cassava on rice paper. Báo Quốc tế is the publisher that describes it: boiled in fresh coconut water, mashed with sugar, salt, and scallion oil, then herbs and boiled pork or fried shrimp.
origin: Củ Chi. Báo Quốc tế, on 11 Aug 2024, describes khoai mì quết cuốn bánh tráng and calls it a dish of this district.
howToEat: Báo Quốc tế: boil the cassava in fresh coconut water until soft, mash it, and mix in sugar, salt, scallion oil, and other seasonings. Spoon it onto rice paper with herbs and sliced boiled pork or fried shrimp.
The headline says a dip of mắm tỏi ớt. The body says mắm tỏi. Both wordings stay.
No price was printed. Check on arrival. The hour is Check on arrival.
